ext.coordination.claude_not_found: claude executable not found (neither CLAUDE_CODE_EXECPATH nor PATH has it)
ext.coordination.conflict_warning: ⚠️ [Guardian:CoordWarn] Another active session ({who}) has also edited this file: {path} (last at {peer_at}, {peer_count} times). In a shared working tree the later write overwrites the earlier one with no automatic merge. Make sure you are not stepping on each other first ({hint}confirm the split with the user if needed), and when finishing, stage only your own files; do not git add -A.
ext.coordination.git_finalize_warning: ⚠️ [Guardian:CoordWarn] A repo-wide git finishing command was detected, and other active sessions in the same working tree have recorded edits: {listed} (they may or may not have committed already; state does not track VCS status, so {ask}verify with git status first). git add -A / reset --hard would sweep up or wipe out others' uncommitted changes. Use selective staging instead (git add <your own files>), and confirm with the user before reset/clean.
ext.coordination.late_collision: ⚠️ [Guardian:CoordWarn] Detected after writing: session {who} also wrote {path} within 60 seconds ({peer_at}). Both sides wrote it for the first time almost at once and could not see each other beforehand; check whether you overwrote their changes{hint}.
ext.coordination.log_write_failed: [Guardian:Coord] Failed to write the observation log (features unaffected): {error}
ext.coordination.peer_names_unavailable: [Guardian:Coord] Could not look up peer session names (claude agents --json failed); warnings show short ids only: {error}
